fields.label: API Key
fields.description: API key for the selected provider.

fields.label: Model (optional)
fields.description: Leave blank to use the provider default. Examples — Claude: claude-sonnet-4-6, Groq: llama-3.3-70b-versatile

Refuse a new Purchase Order for a supplier who already holds an advance paid against an earlier order that has not been invoiced yet. The buyer is warned as soon as the supplier is chosen, and the order cannot be saved.
fields.label: Block New Purchase Order When Supplier Holds an Unbilled Advance

fields.description: Advances at or below this figure are ignored, in company currency. Leave at 0 to block on any amount at all — note that catches trivial balances and invites the override to be clicked through out of habit.
fields.label: Ignore Advances Up To

fields.description: Roles or individual users who may raise the order anyway. Everyone else is stopped. Administrator always may.
fields.label: Allowed to Override
